title: Solarium
description: solarium.com.br Solarium Revestimentos is a Brazilian manufacturer and distributor of ceramic tiles, porcelain, mosaics and decorative wall panels based in São Paulo with over 20 years of market presence. Its product range covers porcelain tiles in marble, concrete, wood and natural stone finishes from 30x30 to 120x260 centimeter formats for residential and commercial projects. With approximately 50 to 150 employees and estimated revenue of 20 to 50 million reais, it distributes through builders, retail chains like Leroy Merlin and its own showrooms across Brazil. The company operates its own manufacturing facility with in-house quality control and ABNT certification. Its portfolio includes decorative panels, geometric patterns, tropical designs and minimal collections alongside standard ceramic and porcelain. Key sectors are residential construction, commercial interiors and hospitality projects.
